---
title: "Teach on Start + Void"
description: "Native Teach Worker, qualification for both production URLs, cutover and rollback."
updatedAt: "2026-11-20"
audience: developers
---

Teach (`apps/teach`) runs as a native TanStack Start app on Vite+ and Void through
[`@tuturuuu/start-bridge`](/build/devops/start-bridge), produced by the
[conversion codemod](/build/devops/start-bridge-codemod). All 44 App Router pages
render unchanged through the generic RSC adapter and every route handler is served
by the bridge API registry. `next build` (package `build`) remains the Vercel path;
production publication stays held in `tuturuuu.ci.ts` until a cutover PR.

## Cutover packet

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Worker | `void.config.ts` emits the staging identity (`TUTURUUU_NOINDEX=1`, `workers_dev` on). The `teach-cutover-artifact` job emits a production artifact named `tuturuuu-teach`, with `workers_dev` and preview URLs off, no routes, and `TUTURUUU_NOINDEX=0`. The config declares no routes |
| Hosts | Root: `teach.tuturuuu.com`. Mount: `tuturuuu.com/teach` |
| Bindings | `ASSETS` (static assets, worker-first, no SPA fallback) |
| Vars (names) | `INTERNAL_WEB_API_ORIGIN` (default `https://tuturuuu.com`), `TUTURUUU_NOINDEX` (staging only) |
| Secrets (names) | `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`, `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY`, `TUTURUUU_APP_COORDINATION_SECRET`. Optional integrations keep the names in `apps/teach/env.example` |
| Build | `bun turbo:local run build --filter=@tuturuuu/teach^...`, then `bun run --cwd apps/teach build:cloudflare`. Output: `dist/server/wrangler.json`, `dist/client` |
| Routing | Keep canonical routing separate. On the apex gateway, bind `MOUNT_TEACH` to `tuturuuu-teach` for `/teach` and `/teach/*` |
| Preimage | Capture the immutable serving deployment, DNS records and canonical route, plus the serving gateway version, routes and bindings |

The production Worker admits `teach.tuturuuu.com` and the exact `/teach` mount
and its descendants on `tuturuuu.com`. The noindex staging profile also supports
preview hosts. The production archive is route-free with public previews off.

## Rollback

Restore the captured gateway version in one operation and verify Web again
handles the apex paths. If a separate subdomain release regresses, restore its
captured route and serving deployment. Teach data remains in Supabase and Storage.

## Smoke

```bash
node scripts/native-cutover/smoke.mjs --origin https://teach.tuturuuu.com --app teach --expect native
curl -sI https://teach.tuturuuu.com/api/build-info            # 200, no-store
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://teach.tuturuuu.com/          # 200, landing page renders
curl -sI 'https://teach.tuturuuu.com/en/dashboard?x=1&x=2'    # localized redirect preserves query
curl -sI 'https://tuturuuu.com/teach?x=1&x=2'                 # mounted landing page
curl -sI https://tuturuuu.com/teach/api/build-info             # same build as the subdomain
```

Run these against a version-pinned, zero-traffic upload before routing. With an
approved test identity on both variants, verify the existing root session, a
localized timetable, lesson and attendance reads, disposable teaching changes
and file uploads with cleanup, and the Web API fallback. After activation, watch
errors, auth, assets and localization for 30–60 minutes and roll back immediately
on regression.

## Qualification

`teach-cloudflare.yaml` builds the native output, rejects route-tree drift,
type-checks (`type-check:cloudflare`), seals the emitted Worker with
`scripts/ci/teach-native-artifact.py` and runs the emitted-Worker suite in workerd
(`bun run --cwd apps/teach test:runtime`, egress denied). The production job runs
the cutover checks on the emitted Worker and repeats them after restoring the
sealed archive in a clean checkout. It checks the whole login redirect chain,
same-origin HTML assets, exact build identity and host admission. The 404 probe
uses `/login/__native-smoke-missing__` because every non-public path redirects
signed-out users to login. `/api/build-info` is public to GET and HEAD through
`proxy.ts`, with ambient cookies and authorization removed, as in Track and Tasks.
Heavy builds run on a remote host, not the local hub.
